pid.description.fuelLevel: Fuel tank level as a percentage of capacity, reported by the car. It is not fuel consumption or remaining range.
pid.description.obdStandard: Identifies the OBD standard the vehicle reports complying with.
pid.description.milDistance: Distance traveled while the malfunction indicator lamp was on.
pid.description.clearedDistance: Distance traveled since diagnostic trouble codes were cleared.
pid.description.moduleVoltage: Voltage reported by the control module; distinct from adapter voltage.
pid.description.railPressure: Fuel rail pressure reported by the control module.
pid.failure.noResponse: The car didn't answer this request. It may not support it right now (some readings only answer with the engine running), or the adapter timed out.
pid.failure.malformed: The car answered, but the bytes were not the length or shape WOBD expects for this parameter. The raw bytes are kept in recordings so they can be decoded later.
pid.failure.invalid: The car answered, but the bytes did not decode to a usable number. The raw bytes are kept in recordings so they can be decoded later.
